messages:
maria: Quick sync — following the postmortem for the Rate Limiter regression, we need to finalize customer-facing follow-ups. Owners & dates for: (1) status page copy, (2) 72h external summary, (3) RCA sharing window + redaction policy. Also flag recurring-incident patterns. Who takes which?

ben: I can take status page copy. Plan: short edit + TL;DR + SLO impact. Draft by Fri EOD. Will post draft here for review. @liz FYI for language check.

liz: Ack. I will review for tone and legal redaction. Will aim to return comments within 24h of your draft. Suggest we use "partial degradation" phrasing vs "outage" where possible. :thumbsup: 

sam: I'll own the RCA sharing policy follow-up. Action: confirm who gets access, redact internal IPs/customer IDs, and propose sharing timeline (public summary in 72h, full RCA available to impacted customers w/ NDA option). Target: Wed COB.

jordan: I'll pull the recurring-pattern analysis and link to remediation tracker. There are 3 similar incidents in last 90 days — I'll add a paragraph in the external summary about "mitigation plan across pattern". ETA: tomorrow morning.

maria: Great. Can we enumerate explicit deliverables and add to the postmortem action tracker? I put a quick list in the doc: ```- Statuspage copy — owner: ben — due: 2026-03-27 EOD
- External 72h summary — owner: liz/jordan — due: 2026-03-25 23:59 UTC
- RCA sharing policy + access list — owner: sam — due: 2026-03-25 COB
- Remediation implement plan update — owner: eng-sre — due: 2026-04-02```

ben: Posting draft now: ```We experienced elevated 429s due to a misrouted quota policy. Impact: ~3% requests, ~12 minutes. Mitigation: fallback routing + hotfix. Next steps: long-term quota fix + observability improvements.``` Comments welcome.

liz: Quick suggestion on copy: remove internal latency numbers; prefer "brief spike in request throttles" and add a link to status page for live updates. Also, add a short "what we're doing to prevent recurrence" paragraph.

sam: Legal asked that we avoid naming specific customers without consent. For RCA access we'll include a short consent form for customers requesting full timeline. Also propose a "customer opt-in to detailed RCA" flow. Will draft consent text.

sre-bot: postmortem filed: https://intra/redwood/postmortems/rl-2026-03-22-1 (automated). Action tracker link added to doc.

maria: One more: for external 72h summary, include an "impact matrix" (who, what, duration) + next steps + contact for follow-up. @ben @liz make sure we have a single point of contact listed.

ben: Will add POC = incidents@redwood.com in draft.

jordan: Uploaded the pattern analysis spreadsheet to the doc and added a short blurb. Noting that same upstream routing change appears in 2/3 incidents — recommend we schedule a targeted audit of routing policies.

liz: LGTM on draft. Minor grammar nits, nothing blocking.

maria: Thanks all. I'll create calendar reminders and ping owners 24h before due dates. If anyone needs to shift deliverables, call it out here. :spiral_calendar:
